Publish.LongDescription:
### **CityForge Reborn:**
A cheat and sandbox panel, rebuilt from scratch. Click the ◆ button in the top-left corner to open it.
**About & Disclaimer**
This is a brand-new mod inspired by the original CityForge. It is not made by, or connected to, the original author, and it contains none of the original's code. Everything was rewritten from the ground up.
Github link is included. Please send bugs, feedback, and open any issues you may encounter there. Pull requests are always welcome. Thank you!
CityForge Reborn is fully open source under the GPL-3.0 license, and it will always stay that way.
**Economy**
* Add or remove money, or infinite money * Jump to any milestone, or unlock them all * Development tree points
**Build**
* Instant construction, or ½× to 4× build speed * Level up buildings, max efficiency * Fill storage, or keep it full * Unlimited water and electricity * No pollution
**People**
* Boost move-ins and tourists (up to 10×) * Max happiness, rich citizens, max education
**Demand**
* Set demand for each zone * Force Build: buildings spawn even with no demand or a poor lot
**Extras**
* Panel colors * Reset cheats on load * Keep achievements on
**Roadmap** (No particular order)
* Translations (support for multiple languages) * Time of day and weather control * Instant garbage, crime and fire cleanup * Unlimited healthcare and education capacity * Max land value * Free building upkeep * Traffic tools: remove stuck vehicles, no accidents * Disasters on/off * Hotkey to open the panel * Save and load cheat presets * Status bar showing active cheats * Lock the achievements option while a city is loaded * Smoother instant construction on big builds * Retry saving settings if another mod is saving

ChangeLog.Value: New: unlimited water, unlimited electricity and no pollution (Build tab).
